从人类撰写的公开协议构建语料，清洗、结构化、受约束任务构造，并结合自动过滤与专家: The corpus is built from human-written public protocols, through cleaning, structuring, and constrained task construction, combined with automatic filtering and expert verification.
Scale当前总榜将Remote Labor Index单列，并展示当前前沿模型: Scale's current overall leaderboard lists Remote Labor Index separately and shows current frontier-model results.
编译提交实现后用行为测试比较原程序，不靠LLM主观评分；有限测试不能证明所有输入: After the submitted implementation is compiled, behavioral tests compare it with the original program; scoring does not rely on subjective LLM judgment, and finite tests cannot prove equivalence on all inputs.
作者主观评价从相对直接到较难；5位人类各答约20题的样本测试，不能当完整题集人类: The authors' subjective ratings run from relatively straightforward to fairly difficult; a sample test in which 5 humans each answer about 20 questions cannot be taken as a human baseline for the full question set.
pass^k（重复k次全成功），也报告平均成功率；与pass@k至少一次成功定义: pass^k (all k repeated trials succeed); the average success rate is also reported; the definition is the opposite of pass@k, which counts at least one success.
数据库数据CC BY 4.0；仓库软件LICENSE为MIT。数据与代码授权范围: Database data are CC BY 4.0; the repository software LICENSE is MIT. The license scopes of data and code are kept distinct.
Apache-2.0（官方仓库 LICENSE；论文版本及第三方原始材料的权利需: Apache-2.0 (official repository LICENSE; rights in the paper version and in third-party original materials need to be distinguished separately)
论文2小时主实验与6小时扩展；OpenAI发布文明确Astra/Sol取消6小时: The paper's 2-hour main experiment and 6-hour extension; the OpenAI release post explicitly states that Astra/Sol remove the 6-hour time limit.
25个目标程序：Unix工具、序列化、查询、生物信息、解释器、静态分析、密码学与: 25 target programs: Unix utilities, serialization, query, bioinformatics, interpreters, static analysis, cryptography, and compression.
实例rubric二元通过准确率；官方榜Rank(UB)另依95%CI统计显著关系: Binary-pass accuracy on the instance rubric; official-leaderboard Rank(UB) is additionally computed from statistically significant relations under the 95% CI.
常见算子数据只覆盖较少物理行为；此库强调不同维数、边界条件、尺度与非线性机制的多: Datasets of common operators cover only a narrow range of physical behavior; this library emphasizes diversity of dimension, boundary conditions, scale, and nonlinear mechanisms.
自然语言+错误代码 → 修复代码；tests 与 docstring 提示有不同: Natural language plus faulty code → repaired code; tests and docstring prompts have different variants.
Weighted Rubric Score：每题满足的临床标准权重比例，三次运行: Weighted Rubric Score: the proportion of clinical-criterion weight satisfied on each question, as the mean of three runs.
每个样本由 3 名独立标注者评价描述和测试；采用最高严重程度标签，任一严重问题均: Each sample's description and tests are rated by 3 independent annotators; the highest-severity label is used, and any serious problem leads to exclusion.
刷新原论文轨；Hunyuan两条继承前轮已核验的H2报告，未重新读该报告，不称新: The original-paper track was refreshed; the two Hunyuan entries inherit the previously verified H2 report, that report was not reread, and this is not presented as a new verification.
MIT（llm-attacks仓库软件与文档；数据/第三方材料适用范围须按制品核: MIT (software and documentation in the llm-attacks repository; the applicable scope of data and third-party materials must be checked per artifact).
只评 Python 难以判断语言模型在其他编程语言中的迁移能力；逐语言手工造题成: Evaluating only Python makes it difficult to judge how well a language model transfers to other programming languages; writing questions by hand for each language is costly.
rubric评分、微调评估器分数和二值ASR不同；评估器MAE也不是目标模型的安: Rubric scores, fine-tuned evaluator scores, and binary ASR are different; evaluator MAE is also not a safety score for the target model.
跨数学、科学、人文等高阶学科，评估具有明确答案的专家级知识与推理，以及模型置信度: Across higher-level disciplines such as mathematics, science, and the humanities, it evaluates expert-level knowledge and reasoning with definite answers, and calibration of model confidence.
基础/slow-thinking/fast-thinking分别报告BBH；不是: BBH is reported separately for base/slow-thinking/fast-thinking; they are not the same track
BioCoder-Rosalind / Summary Only / 官网历史展: BioCoder-Rosalind / Summary Only / historical display order on the official site
仅记录Epoch公开的benchmark工作联系渠道，不收集游戏玩家或第三方个人: Only the publicly stated Epoch contact channel for benchmark work is recorded; personal information of game players or third parties is not collected.
OTIS 2024、2025 I、2025 II三套非官方模拟AIME试卷，各1: Three unofficial mock AIME papers, OTIS 2024, 2025 I, and 2025 II, with 15 questions each.
数学专家编写此前未发表的原创题，覆盖数论、分析、代数几何、范畴论等；答案可由程序: Mathematics experts write previously unpublished original questions, covering number theory, analysis, algebraic geometry, category theory, and others; answers can be verified by a program.
HF公开10项目数据卡明确en；完整私有集语言分布待核实，不能外推为所有文件都仅: The public HF data card for 10 projects explicitly states en; the language distribution of the full private set is Unverified, and it cannot be extrapolated that every file is English only.
有继承公开任务与分子库，不能将提示改写视为已去预训练污染；独立模型训练语料审计待: It inherits public tasks and molecular libraries, so prompt rewriting cannot be treated as removal of pretraining contamination; an independent audit of model training corpora is Unverified.
lupantech/MathVista项目团队；Pan Lu为官网公开结果提交联: The lupantech/MathVista project team; Pan Lu is the contact, listed on the official site, for submission of public results.
任何blocking检查失败或查找解被轨迹扫描标记，整次尝试0分；其余按各项权重: If any blocking check fails, or a looked-up solution is flagged by trajectory scanning, the entire attempt scores 0; otherwise the items are summed by their weights.
按活动类别设置in-domain与zero-shot类别；这不等于现代预训练污染: In-domain and zero-shot categories are set by activity category; this is not the same as a modern audit of pretraining contamination.
标题相同，19名署名；bioRxiv另列Jeremy Li，应保留文档版本/署名: The titles are the same, with 19 named authors; bioRxiv additionally lists Jeremy Li, and the difference in document version and byline should be retained.
v1.1回应reward hacking反馈并强化环境，公开上游代码仍有训练污染: v1.1 responds to reward-hacking feedback and strengthens the environment; the public upstream code still carries a risk of training contamination.
单条user消息给问题和原图，无system、few-shot或代码/裁剪/缩放: A single user message gives the question and the original image, with no system message, few-shot examples, or code, crop, or zoom tools.
HeyGen 原版与 AA 实现题量、裁判不同，Elo 不可互比；Elo 依赖对: The original HeyGen version and the AA implementation differ in the number of questions and in the judge, so their Elo scores cannot be compared with each other; Elo depends on the opponent pool.
CSV存在1.0.4、1.1.0、1.2.1，不能把不同版本的历史最高直接视为同: The CSV contains 1.0.4, 1.1.0, and 1.2.1, so historical highs from different versions cannot be treated directly as a leaderboard for one version.
Vals AI当前方法与榜单实际评测多模型；主要单一机构当前展示，不代表行业广泛: The current Vals AI methods and leaderboard actually evaluate multiple models; the current presentation is mainly from a single institution and does not represent broad industry adoption.
Scale当前总榜将DrugDiscoveryBench单列，并展示当前前沿模型: Scale's current overall leaderboard lists DrugDiscoveryBench separately and shows current frontier-model results.
Google Research、Stanford University（论文署名: Google Research, Stanford University (institutions named on the paper)
纯文本：带空白的英语句子、两个候选名词短语及1/2答案；不是数学题，也不含图像/: Plain text: an English sentence containing a blank, two candidate noun phrases, and a 1/2 answer; it is not a mathematics problem and contains no image/video.
PRBench公开Finance 600题 / Hard 300题（本次可核验发: PRBench public Finance 600 questions / Hard 300 questions (release set verifiable in this check)
论文主要比较每题8样本、最高可用推理档；AA为4次重复，用GPT-5.4 low: The paper mainly compares 8 samples per question at the highest available reasoning setting; AA uses 4 repetitions, judged by GPT-5.4 low.
TSR=全部目标实体都正确的录音比例；CTEM=正确实体比例；WER/WAcc作: TSR=the proportion of recordings in which every target entity is correct; CTEM=the proportion of correct entities; WER/WAcc are auxiliary.
2025年9月由看真值的LLM判断改成不看真值的答案提取后精确匹配，减少空白答案: In September 2025, judgment by an LLM that sees the ground truth was changed to exact match after answer extraction that does not see the ground truth, reducing misjudgment of blank answers.
数据卡数量为57个学科配置num_examples的精确求和，不重复加all聚合: The count on the data card is the exact sum of num_examples across 57 subject configurations, without adding the all aggregate configuration a second time.
